number_of_cells.description: initial number of cells (for each cell type)

oxygen_memory_alpha.description: exponential moving average weight for oxygen and pressure memory

hypoxia_threshold.description: oxygen threshold that activates HIF1A stress response

hypoxia_hif1a_gain.description: HIF1A increase per oxygen unit below threshold

panic_delta_o2_threshold.description: oxygen drop threshold that triggers panic response

panic_tp53_gain.description: TP53 gain multiplier under sharp oxygen drop

phosgene_toxin_hif1a_gain.description: HIF1A gain from phosgene-like injury field

phosgene_toxin_tp53_gain.description: TP53 gain from phosgene-like injury field

phosgene_toxin_mki67_scale.description: MKI67 multiplier under high phosgene-like injury

phosgene_toxin_apoptosis_gain.description: apoptosis rate multiplier gain from phosgene-like injury field
